answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 1 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in mirror, checked in falcon, and kernel shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3744 identities would post 2549 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
